Subject: PO metadata & invoice cadence questions for Redwood quote

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the quick quote. A couple procurement items we need confirmed before issuing a PO:

- Required PO fields: does Redwood need a specific account or cost-center code on the PO to trigger discounts?
- Invoice cadence: can we get monthly invoices consolidated across Atlas subsidiaries, or do you require separate invoices per legal entity?
- Net terms: standard is Net 30 for most vendors here; we may need Net 45 for one subsidiary — is that acceptable?
- Packaging: for this ML platform SKU, is it possible to convert seat-based pricing to a usage bucket in the order form to simplify billing?

Attached is our standard PO template for your team to review (PO_Template_Atlas.xlsx). We will also need a short note from finance confirming any early-pay or commitment discounts and what metadata needs to be on the PO to apply those.

Can we get a short write-up that we can attach to the PO submission? We're aiming to submit next week.

Appreciate it —
Lena Park

Hi Lena —

Thanks — apologies for the delayed note. Below is a concise list you can attach to the PO submission. I copied Vanessa (Finance) and Ben (Sales ops) for any detailed follow-ups.

Redwood PO acceptance summary (please include on the PO):
- Mandatory fields: PO number, billing entity legal name, remit-to address (Redwood Inference, Inc.), Redwood customer account ID (we'll provide), currency, and invoice frequency (monthly/weekly).
- Optional but required for discount mapping: commitment_id or order_form_id referenced in the PO notes (e.g., OF-48012). This must match the signed order form.
- For multi-entity setups: include a master_agreement_reference and the subsidiary legal entity code (if invoices should be split).

Invoice cadence and net terms:
- Default hosted customers: monthly invoicing, Net 30.
- Enterprise exceptions: Net 45 can be approved by Finance for qualifying entities (requires request on company letterhead + PO referencing order_form_id).
- Weekly/ fortnightly pre-bill: available as an operational exception for high-volume customers; requires separate pre-bill PO line and agreed workflow.

Discounts and packaging guidance:
- Commitment discounts are applied only when the signed order form or SOW is on file AND the incoming PO references the commitment_id.
- Typical discounts: 5% for 12-month committed spend with monthly invoicing; 10% for 12-month upfront payment.
- Packaging: seat -> usage conversion is doable but treated as a contractual change. We can map seats to a usage bucket on the order form; billing will reflect usage metering and may require a minimum committed monthly spend to preserve the discount.

See attached: Redwood_PO_Instructions.pdf (short checklist for your procurement team).

If you confirm whether Atlas can include the commitment_id on the PO, I can escalate Net 45 for the specific subsidiary and produce a revised invoice cadence note for your AP team.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 415-555-0123

Hi Lena —

Quick finance note to clarify how we apply discounts and handle split POs: 

1) Split POs / Multi-entity invoicing:
- We can accept multiple POs across subsidiaries provided each PO references the master_order_form_id and maps to the Redwood customer account ID.
- Each invoice will be issued to the legal entity named on the PO. If you prefer a consolidated monthly statement, we can provide a consolidated statement but invoices must still be separately receipted by each legal entity for your ERP.

2) Discount mechanics:
- Discounts are applied at invoice generation only when: (a) the signed order form exists in Dropbox/DocuSign, and (b) the incoming PO includes commitment_id/order_form_id exactly as on the order form.
- Timing: Finance requires receipt of signed order form and PO within 30 days of subscription start to lock the committed discount. Late POs may be subject to prorating or loss of discount for the elapsed period.

3) Early-pay / cash discounts:
- We are typically open to small early-pay discounts (1% within 10 days) but those are contractual and need to be explicitly stated on the order form. The discount applies to the invoice amount excluding any third-party pass-through charges and usage overages.

If you want, I can countersign a short annex for Net 45 for the named Atlas subsidiary and note the early-pay term. Otherwise, Mateo and I can produce a DocuSign-ready order form that includes the PO metadata fields you need.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Tom / Lena —

Good news — we can accommodate your requests with the following constraints (summary you can attach to the PO):

1) Net terms / early-pay: Redwood will accept Net 45 for the named Atlas subsidiary provided the PO references the order_form_id (OF-48012) and the signed order form is on file. We will honor a 1% early-pay discount if payment is received within 10 days of invoice date. The early-pay discount applies to the invoice subtotal and explicitly excludes third-party pass-throughs and any usage overages above committed amounts.

2) Commitment discount / timing: The 5% commitment discount (12-month, monthly invoicing) will apply prospectively once the signed order form and PO are received. If PO receipt is delayed beyond the 30-day window we described, the discount may be prorated for the period before PO effective date.

3) Seat-to-usage mapping: We can implement a billing-side mapping so invoices reflect a usage bucket while the contract references seat allocations; this requires a one-page amendment (we will prepare) and a minimum committed monthly floor to preserve pricing. It is not a full rework of the order form, but we will include the mapping clause in the annex.

I attached a revised quote showing Net 45 + 1% early-pay and the commitment discount language. If Atlas can confirm the PO will include OF-48012 and the legal entity code for the Net 45 subsidiary, we will instruct AP to route invoices as requested and lock the discount.

Next steps:
- Lena: please confirm which billing entity will be Net 45 and if you will include OF-48012 on the PO.
- Tom: once confirmed, I will send a DocuSign-ready amendment for signature and a final quote to attach.

Best regards,
Mateo Alvarez
